title: Static biological aging as a sustainable method for low-alcohol sherry wines: impact on composition and typicity
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00733J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lourdes Vega-Espinar, Raquel Muñoz-Castells, Victor Palacios, Juan Moreno, Cristina Lasanta
Lower-alcohol static biological aging boosts flor metabolism and preserves sherry typicity. This approach enhances industry sustainability by reducing fortification costs and CO2 emissions.
